mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when RSAFS and INDPRO growth exceed 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the following 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Continued growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions and economic strength, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500.0 thousand units signals weak consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.0% and unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a stimulative monetary policy environment amid high joblessness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: stimulative monetary policy with high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO falling), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the subsequent 60 trading days due to reduced economic output and increased inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 60% of instances during supply shock regimes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
